query:
VALUE total INT64 = 0
VALUE i INT64 = 1
WHILE i <= $n THEN {
  SET total = total + i
  SET i = i + 1
}
RETURN total AS total
notes: Assumes the evaluator binds external parameter $n as INT64 in the public range -2 through 6. The zero initializer remains the result when n <= 0.
